assumptions.interest: Simple interest on opening principal, APR / 52, rounded weekly; no compounding.
assumptions.paymentOrder: Income, essentials, due interest, due principal; loan payments preserve the configured buffer.
assumptions.schedule: Baseline schedules stay fixed during stress testing. No extensions, fees, forgiveness, or penalty interest.
assumptions.history: Historical repayments are prior lending observations, not payments against the new simulated loan.
assumptions.forecast: Corresponding weeks from the prior two years; sustained decline scales by the recent year-on-year ratio.
assumptions.limits: Synthetic scenario estimates. No calibrated default probabilities. Not an automated lending decision.

assessment.summary: Income is below the same period last year across three recent four-week windows. This supports a persistent decline flag; it does not establish the cause.

evidence.label: Recent income / same 13 weeks last year

reasons: None of the four schedules repays the loan by maturity while preserving the buffer and avoiding arrears and unmet essentials.
Review loan terms and income assumptions with the borrower. Remaining balances are shown for every plan.
